title: HyperCAD-S CAD Automation + Mock Layer
description: Build HyperCADSAutomationEngine for CAD API coverage (import/heal/analyze/stock-model), PrintToHyperCADSBridge for STEP-to-AC-Python import workflow, HyperCADSStockModelEngine for automated offset solid creation, FeatureToStrategyBridgeEngine for feature-to-strategy recommendations, and a HyperCADSMockLayer for CI testability without USB key. Addresses Agent 1 finding (14/100 CAD score) and Agent 19 defect #4 (untestable without USB).

engines: HyperMillCodeGeneratorEngine.ts (982 LOC — AC Python script generation pattern)
HyperMillStrategyEngine.ts (492 LOC — 20+ strategies for feature-to-strategy mapping)
physics: constants.ts (stock allowance defaults, material thermal expansion)

sessions.title: HyperCADSAutomationEngine + PrintToHyperCADSBridge + StockModelEngine
sessions.intent: Build the three core CAD automation engines that give PRISM programmatic control over hyperCAD-S operations via Automation Center Python scripts. Each engine generates AC Python code for its domain (import/heal, stock model, feature extraction).

units.title: Build HyperCADSAutomationEngine — CAD API automation via AC Python
units.description: Create HyperCADSAutomationEngine with actions: hyperCADS_import (STEP/IGES/DXF → AC Python import script), hyperCADS_heal (geometry healing + normal alignment script), hyperCADS_analyze (draft/undercut/wall thickness analysis script). Uses same AC Python generation pattern as HyperMillCodeGeneratorEngine. Outputs executable Python scripts for Automation Center.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperCADSAutomationEngine.ts exports singleton with 3 actions
Each action generates valid AC Python script strings
tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors
3 unit tests verify script output structure

units.title: Build PrintToHyperCADSBridge — STEP path → AC Python import → heal → set workpiece
units.description: Create PrintToHyperCADSBridge that chains: file validation → import script generation → heal script generation → stock model assignment. Takes a STEP file path and material specification, outputs a complete AC Python script sequence that imports, heals, and prepares the part for CAM.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: PrintToHyperCADSBridge.ts exports singleton
Generates chained AC Python script from STEP path + material input
Validates STEP file extension and material lookup against MaterialRegistry
2 unit tests verify end-to-end bridge output

units.title: Build HyperCADSStockModelEngine — automated offset solid creation for finishing allowances
units.description: Create HyperCADSStockModelEngine that generates AC Python scripts for stock model creation: bounding box stock, offset solid with configurable allowances (axial/radial), cylinder stock from OD. Hooks into hyperCADS-import-validation to ensure stock model is always created before CAM operations.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperCADSStockModelEngine.ts exports singleton with 3 stock generation modes
Offset solid uses allowance values from constants.ts (not hardcoded)
hyperCADS-import-validation hook BUILT and registered
3 unit tests for bounding box, offset solid, and cylinder stock modes

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ 3 CAD engines built and exported | ✓ AC Python scripts generate valid syntax | ✓ hyperCADS-import-validation hook registered | ✓ tsc 0 errors | ✓ 8+ tests pass | omega_floor >= 0.90 | SVI delta: +1%

sessions.title: FeatureToStrategyBridgeEngine + HyperCADSMockLayer for CI
sessions.intent: Build the feature-to-strategy recommendation bridge and a mock layer that allows all HyperCAD-S engines to be tested in CI without a USB key. Mock layer intercepts AC Python execution and returns deterministic test fixtures.

units.title: Build FeatureToStrategyBridgeEngine — recognized features → strategy recommendations
units.description: Create FeatureToStrategyBridgeEngine that maps recognized geometric features (pocket, hole, boss, slot, freeform surface) to recommended hyperMILL strategies from HyperMillStrategyEngine. Uses feature geometry (depth, width, draft angle, surface area) to select optimal cycle type from HyperMillCycleCatalogEngine.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: FeatureToStrategyBridgeEngine.ts maps 10+ feature types to strategies
References HyperMillStrategyEngine and HyperMillCycleCatalogEngine
Recommendations include cycle type + rationale string
4 unit tests covering pocket, hole, boss, and freeform features

units.title: Build HyperCADSMockLayer — CI test fixture for all CAD engines
units.description: Create HyperCADSMockLayer that intercepts all AC Python script execution calls and returns deterministic test fixtures. Provides mock responses for import (feature list), heal (repair report), analyze (draft/undercut report), and stock model (bounding box). Enables full CI testing of MS0-MS9 engines without hyperMILL USB key. Wire into test setup with HYPERMILL_MOCK=true environment variable.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

Mock fixtures match real AC Python response schemas
3 unit tests verify mock layer intercept and response shape
